description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Created `GitView.vue`** — a presentational Git view mockup (branch/commit sidebar, changed-files list, mock diff, history tab) using DaisyUI.
2. **Registered it as an app** — added `'git-view'` to `appComponentsMap.js`, declared the `git-view` app in `apps.js`, and added an `openGitView()` action in `store/ui.js`.
3. **Fixed a build-breaking bug** — literal `</script>` / `<script setup>` strings inside the SFC script closed the block early; solved via string concatenation.
4. **Refactored to Vue3 profile** — moved `ref`/`computed`/functions out of `<script setup>` into the `export default` object (`data` → `computed` → `methods`).
5. **Wired navigation** — added Git entries to `AppsSection.vue` and `MainMenuItems.vue`, plus the `git-view` route in `router/index.ts` and helpers in `router/navigate.js`.

Here's what I found and my plan. `src/config/appComponentsMap.js` (the app→component registry) + `src/config/apps.js` (the app registry) are the two places apps are declared for the **apps** catalog, and `src/store/ui.js` holds the `openApp`/opener actions the **MainMenu** items call. So "AppsSection" = the app registries, "MainMenu" = the menu (and the store openers it uses). There is no existing `GitView` component — the `src/components/repo/` folder groups the git/PR components, so the new mockup belongs there. ## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking - **Core Requirements**: Add a presentational **Git view mockup** component, then register it as an openable app and expose it in the menus. - **Strategic Approach**: Create `GitView.vue` (DaisyUI, static mock data — no API calls); import + map it in `appComponentsMap.js`; declare it in the `APPS` registry (`apps.js`); add an `openGitView()` store action (`ui.js`); add a menu entry in `MainMenuItems.vue`. - **Dependencies & Risks**: `apps.js` `route` references a named route (`git-view`) that does not exist yet in the router — desktop panels work fine; single/mobile mode would fall through the `/*` catch-all until a route is added. Keep the component dependency-free so it renders standalone. - **Target Files**: - `src/components/repo/GitView.vue` (create) - `src/config/appComponentsMap.js` (modify) - `src/config/apps.js` (modify) - `src/store/ui.js` (modify) - `src/components/main-menu/MainMenuItems.vue` (modify) ## 2.
